run_delete_named_actor: run the script to kill a named Ray actor by name and namespace on a Ray cluster
run_delete_named_actor_cli: run the CLI tool to delete a named Ray actor using hostname port actor name and namespace
review_delete_named_actor: review the delete_named_actor function that connects to a Ray cluster and kills a named actor
summarize_delete_named_actor: summarize the delete_named_actor function that uses ray.get_actor and ray.kill to remove actors
test_delete_named_actor: test the delete_named_actor function by providing a Ray head URL actor name and namespace
